description: This PHP class 'TimesheetDecorator' provides a decorator pattern implementation for the 'Timesheet' entity within the OrangeHRM system. It adds presentation-layer methods such as formatted start/end dates, setting an employee by number, and formatting the timesheet's state.

classes.name: TimesheetDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for Timesheet entity providing formatted representations and helper methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a Timesheet instance.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the timesheet formatted as a string.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the timesheet formatted as a string.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the timesheet using an employee number.

methods.name: getTimesheetState
methods.description: Returns the timesheet's state as a human-readable string.
